description: This file contains routines for managing floating point register sharing in an x86 architecture within the Zephyr RTOS. It includes functions for enabling/disabling FP support, saving/restoring FP context, and handling related exceptions.

methods.name: z_FpAccessDisable
methods.description: Disallows use of floating point instructions by setting CR0[TS] to 1.

methods.name: z_do_fp_regs_save
methods.description: Saves the non-integer floating point context using FNSAVE instruction.

methods.name: z_do_fp_and_sse_regs_save
methods.description: Saves floating point and SSE registers using FXSAVE instruction.

methods.name: z_do_fp_regs_init
methods.description: Initializes floating point registers with FNINIT.

methods.name: FpCtxSave
methods.description: Saves a thread’s floating point context, including SSE if supported.

methods.name: FpCtxInit
methods.description: Initializes a thread’s floating point context, including SSE if supported.

methods.name: z_float_enable
methods.description: Enables floating point support for a thread, setting up context and ownership.

methods.name: z_float_disable
methods.description: Disables floating point support for a thread, clearing ownership and disabling FP instructions.

methods.name: _FpNotAvailableExcHandler
methods.description: Handles the 'device not available' exception to enable FP for the current thread.
